label: RBv2
reply:
**Status: Settlement prepared for human approval**

The claims system confirms that stage_settlement succeeded. The payment is pending approval by a Veridia claims handler and has not been paid.

**Facts recorded**
- Claim reference: RBv2-CLM-06_r2
- Policy VER-1004, policyholder Thomas Petit, who was driving at the time (per the email)
- Vehicle: Volkswagen Golf (2020), market value €15,500. Driving licence dated 1 November 2008.
- Coverage: C2 Collision damage, listed in the Policy Schedule
- Incident 8 October 2026, reported 10 October 2026 (2 days after the incident)
- Customer admits fault for a rear-end collision in a traffic jam. Mr. Blanc is named and a signed accident report exists. No claim has been made for Mr. Blanc's vehicle.
- Repair quote stated in the email: €1,500. The email does not say whether this includes VAT.
- Documents received: damage_photos.zip, repair_quote.pdf, accident_report_signed.pdf (not opened)

**Reasoning**
- **Coverage:** C2 covers damage to the insured vehicle after a collision, and C2 is in the Policy Schedule <cite document_id="2630#10414" pages="1-2" name="contract.pdf"/>.
- **Timing:** The claim was reported within the deadline. Late claims go to a handler only if they are past the Article 4.1 deadline <cite document_id="2630#10414" pages="3" name="contract.pdf"/>. The system check found the report on time.
- **Exclusions:** None signalled. The email mentions no alcohol, licence or similar issues.
- **Deductible:** €300 standard C2 deductible <cite document_id="2630#10414" pages="1-2" name="contract.pdf"/>. The not-at-fault waiver (Art. 5.2) does not apply because the customer was at fault. The young-driver surcharge (Art. 5.3) does not apply because the licence is more than 3 years old <cite document_id="2630#10414" pages="2" name="contract.pdf"/>.
- **Assessor:** Required only when the repair cost is above €1,500 (Art. 6.1) <cite document_id="2630#10414" pages="2" name="contract.pdf"/>. The €1,500 figure is not above that threshold.
- **Payout:** Repair cost, capped at market value, minus the deductible (Art. 6.2) <cite document_id="2630#10414" pages="2" name="contract.pdf"/>.
- **Documents:** The system found no missing documents, so no request was sent.

**Amounts (from compute_settlement only)**
- Deductible: €300
- Payout: €1,200 (€1,500 − €300)
- Assessor required: No

**Points for the handler to check before approval**
1. **VAT:** Article 1 defines repair cost as the total including VAT, from the "total incl. VAT" line of the quote <cite document_id="2630#10414" pages="1" name="contract.pdf"/>. The email gives only "€1,500" and does not say whether this is VAT-inclusive. The system used €1,500 as the repair cost. Please check repair_quote.pdf. If the VAT-inclusive total is above €1,500, an assessor is required under Article 6.1, and the payout would change.
2. **Contract coverage:** I read the General Conditions up to Article 2 and the Article 5–7 section through search. The subagent could not open the contract in its own environment, so the system's calculation is taken as the source for the amounts.

**Draft message to the customer**

Dear Mr. Petit,

Thank you for reporting the accident of 8 October 2026 under policy VER-1004 (claim reference RBv2-CLM-06_r2). We have received your damage photos, repair quote and signed accident report. Your claim has been passed to our claims team for final review, and we will contact you once it has been confirmed.

Kind regards,
Veridia Claims
